sloka: समाप्ते नियमे तस्य ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ।पपात पुष्पवर्षं च क्षुभिताश्चापि देवताः ।। ७.१०.७ ॥
transliteration: samāpte niyame tasya nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।papāta puṣpavarṣaṁ ca kṣubhitāścāpi devatāḥ ।। 7.10.7 ॥

translations.english: When his austerity was completed, the hosts of apsaras danced, a rain of flowers fell, and the gods too were stirred with joy.
